paper_method: FastQC; Reaper (Q20, 30–150 nt); STAR 2.4.0a to mm10; featureCounts 1.4.5
detail: The paper's own count matrix from GEO (GSE122952) is used, so its alignment and counting are kept. NeuroVIP's runs re-aligned the same 8 SRA runs to GRCm39 / Ensembl 115 with STAR 2.7.10a.

paper_method: DESeq2; BH padj ≤ 0.05; |FC| ≥ 1.5; combined mean ≥ 5 reads
detail: DESeq2 (pydeseq2) on the GEO matrix after the ≥ 5-read filter (16,362 genes): 4,397 up / 4,382 down at padj ≤ 0.05, 3,318 / 3,095 with the 1.5-fold cut-off. Without the read filter: 4,419 / 4,432 of 19,190. The GEO values are already DESeq2-normalised and rounded, so size factors are ≈ 1.

paper_method: PCA of meningitis vs healthy microvessels
detail: VST, top 500 most variable genes (DESeq2 plotPCA): PC1 93.6 %, PC2 2.7 %. All 16,362 genes scaled to unit variance: PC1 53.9 %, PC2 14.2 %. Paper: Dim 1 39.2 %, Dim 2 14.1 % (exact PCA settings not stated).

paper_method: Complete hierarchical clustering of the samples
detail: Euclidean distances between samples on VST values, complete linkage (R hclust default). The supplementary figure was not available for comparison.

paper_method: Row Z-scores of the 25 most significant up- and down-regulated genes
detail: Per-sample VST Z-scores. Of the paper's 25 up and 25 down genes, 22 and 21 are in the top 25 here (paper-count run). The paper's label '40057' is Sept9 after Excel date conversion.

paper_method: Normalised reads of HIF-1α, VEGF, IL-1β, ANGPT2, Tie2, vWF, PECAM, ZO-1, claudin-5, occludin
detail: Per-sample normalised counts from the GEO matrix, with DESeq2 results from all three runs.

paper_method: KOBAS 2.0 (KEGG, PANTHER, Reactome) on genes regulated in all four infected samples (p < 0.05, |log2FC| > 0.585)
detail: Hypergeometric test with BH correction per database (as KOBAS) on current official KEGG, PANTHER 3.6.8 and Reactome mouse gene sets; universe = 16,362 tested genes; 4,715 selected genes. 'Regulated in all four' is read as: every infected sample ≥ 1.5-fold from the healthy mean. 43 of 50 KEGG and 5 of 15 PANTHER pathways from the paper's figure reach q ≤ 0.05. Database versions differ from the paper's (2019), so membership and rankings shift.
Paper-count run at padj ≤ 0.05: 4,397 up (+0.3 %) / 4,382 down (+0.6 %). With the stated 1.5-fold cut-off: 3,318 / 3,095, so the reported counts appear to use padj only.
